History (beta)

Each column is a period: the calendar half-years, then the last 6 months. A cell is the number and its score (0 to 10), number · score. Trend draws the score over the periods.

history_days is 90, too short for the last 6 months: set history_days to at least 180 in forsgren.config.yml, and this page fills over the next runs.
